posts.title: BYD needs 3 assembly plants and 1 battery factory for long-term European expansion, adviser says
posts.summary:
BYD will need 4 European plants over the long term to support its sales targets and comply with EU regulations, its regional adviser said.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: BYD plans a long-term European manufacturing footprint consisting of three vehicle assembly plants and one dedicated battery factory to bypass trade barriers and meet local demand.

The company is prioritizing the acquisition and refurbishment of existing underutilized facilities over greenfield construction, with Spain and France identified as leading candidates for the second site.
Local production is becoming a strategic imperative for BYD as the EU considers additional tariffs on hybrid vehicles and enforces stricter 'Made in Europe' manufacturing requirements.

posts.title: EU seeks curbs on Chinese hybrid exports or may raise tariffs
posts.summary:
The EU is seeking a negotiated deal to limit imports of China-made hybrids and may raise tariffs if no agreement is reached.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: The European Union is pressuring China to voluntarily limit hybrid vehicle exports, citing a massive surge in imports from 3,800 units in October 2024 to 50,000 in July 2026.
The EU has threatened to increase tariffs beyond the current 10% rate if a negotiated agreement to curb shipments is not reached.
This move represents a significant expansion of the EU's trade defense measures, as the bloc attempts to protect its domestic automotive industry from a broader wave of Chinese electrification.

posts.title: AI’s Storage Problem Is a Packaging Problem
posts.summary:
How thinner dies, taller stacks, and hybrid bonding are carrying NAND into the AI era.
The post AI’s Storage Problem Is a Packaging Problem appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: The rapid growth of AI and high-resolution media is driving structural, long-term demand for NAND flash, shifting the market away from traditional consumer-driven cycles.
Memory manufacturers are prioritizing HBM and advanced DRAM production for AI, which is creating capacity constraints for standard NAND and DRAM products.
Advanced packaging techniques, including thinner dies and hybrid bonding, are now essential to making high-density memory stacks manufacturable for AI infrastructure.

posts.title: Driving Power Delivery Innovations For The AI Data Center
posts.summary:
As AI systems scale, advanced power delivery innovations are becoming critical to performance, efficiency and reliability.
The post Driving Power Delivery Innovations For The AI Data Center appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: Rising current densities in AI accelerators are pushing traditional power delivery networks to their physical limits, necessitating new architectural approaches.
Intel Foundry is implementing backside power delivery and integrated voltage regulators (IVR) to move power conversion closer to the point of load.
Optimizing power integrity at the die and package level is becoming a primary constraint for the performance and reliability of next-generation data center systems.

posts.title: From Silicon To Systems: Heterogeneous Integration As The Engine Of AI Performance
posts.summary:
Design space exploration must become a core capability for advanced packaging and chiplet-based systems. 
The post From Silicon To Systems: Heterogeneous Integration As The Engine Of AI Performance appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: Advanced packaging has evolved from a final protection step into an architectural foundation for heterogeneous systems, enabling performance beyond monolithic silicon limits.
The industry is shifting toward a 'systems mindset,' where design space exploration includes the package, board, and software to optimize AI-specific workloads.
Disaggregating designs into chiplets allows for the mixing of process nodes and foundries, providing a critical path to managing the power and thermal constraints of AI.
